title: arm.json
description: One reviewer configuration as data. Nothing here is observed; observations belong to attempt.json. A skill_tree of 'current' is resolved once at run start and frozen in the run manifest.

model.description: Model identifier requested, or null for the harness default (recorded as observed).

effort.description: Session effort requested, or null for the harness default.

skill_tree.description: review-code only: a git tree hash, or 'current'.

sandbox.description: e.g. workspace-write for codex; n/a for claude arms.

unprivileged_user.description: Unix user the reviewer runs as, or null when the enforced sandbox is not in use.

expected_prompt_variants.description: Registry headers or hashes this arm is expected to match; a mismatch is recorded, not silently accepted.
